result: Added an explicit overlay metadata validator and schema contract. ROM/VMA formulas for the main segment are rejected; ROM and VMA overlaps are independently rejected; file-backed sections and VMA-only BSS are represented separately; function provenance fields are required.
tests: python3 -m unittest decomp.test_overlay_manifest -v — PASS: 8 synthetic tests
limitations: The schema is not wired into decomp.verify.
The validator checks metadata structure and hash syntax, not the referenced ROM/ELF bytes or relocation semantics.
No overlay function was promoted and no main-segment behavior changed.
next: G64-052 through G64-055 must bind actual file_43 layout, section hashes, symbols and relocations before a production adapter is considered.
